decided.singular: These are the near-black cells (level 7-9) standing out against mid-grey neighbours, with day 316 the only level-9 cell.
decided.recurrence: In the 27-day-wide grid, darker cells line up in the +11 to +14 columns across many rows (e.g. rows starting 28, 55, 82, 109, 136, 244, 298, 325), so activity repeats about once per row.
decided.quarter: Rows 271-365 have the most dark cells (273-275, 291, 309-310, 316-317, 337, 344-345), including the single darkest one, while Q3 (rows 190-244) is mostly pale.

answer.guess: A planetary geomagnetic activity index such as Kp (8 three-hourly values per day), with recurrence tied to the 27-day solar rotation.
